mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235.0) triggers fears of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals economic weakness, prompting the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) reflects a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is above 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) indicates a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint strength in HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%) indicates an active monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%.
